Never was seen such an army, pitiful, futile, unfit; Never was seen such a spirit, manifold courage and grit. Never has been such a cohort under one banner unrolled As surged to the ragged-edged Arctic, urged by the arch-tempter—Gold.

futile: useless · manifold: of many kinds · cohort: a band of people · banner: a flag carried at the front · arch-tempter: the greatest tempter, the one who lures people into wrong

🔍 Fair or Not?
Four statements answer one claim. Judge each.
0 / 4
The claimA good master needs knowledge more than kindness.
1The mail driver was skilled and kind at once: when Dave fought to get back to the sled, the driver “had not the heart to strike harder.” Maybe knowledge and kindness can’t be pulled apart.
2Some people think dogs do not need any food at all.
3François came back with “a heavy club in his hand,” so maybe toughness matters more than either.
4Knowledge is clearly the most important thing for a master.

Semicolons, colons and pairs in your own writing
Professor Lovelore At the board
0:42
An AI-generated character and voice.
One · Test every semicolon
The trail was soft; the pulling was hard.→Cover it. Both sides stand alone.
Two · Finish before a colon
Mercedes wanted: her tent and her clothes.→Not finished yet. Mercedes wanted two things: her tent and her clothes.→Finished.
Three · Pairs come in pairs
neither→nor either→or not only→but also both→and
The turn in a counterclaim
It is true that Buck leads well; however, look at how he leads.→The semicolon holds the turn.

🪶 The Writer’s Desk: Quick Write 4, Answer the Other Side, Then Conclude
Step 3 of 3: revise
1 Plan2 Draft3 Revise
Professor Lovelore In the writer’s room
0:28
An AI-generated character and voice.
Four lenses for your draft
  1. Counterclaim. The other side is stated fairly, at its strongest, with a detail.
  2. Answer. You turn back to your claim with evidence, not just disagreement.
  3. Conclusion. Your claim is back in fresh words, with nothing new.
  4. Joins. Every semicolon, colon and pair is tested.
100 to 180 words · claim at the top
